narration_updates.key: "Completeness is not efficiency. <bookmark mark='a'/> Give the prover eight family facts and three rules, and ask whether Anne is an ancestor of Flora, four generations away. <bookmark mark='b'/> " + sat_verdict + " <bookmark mark='c'/> The set-of-support strategy, from Larry Wos and colleagues in 1965, resolves only pairs involving the negated goal or its descendants. " + sos_verdict + " <bookmark mark='d'/> Provers live or die by such strategies.
